summary: Added effectiveMaxDepth(totalWorkPackages, configMax?) to workflow-helpers.ts per §18.2.1: returns max(configMax=50, totalWPs×20). Updated buildHandoffResponse to use effectiveMaxDepth(root.total_work_packages ?? 0) instead of getMaxHandoffDepth(). Updated DEFAULT_CONFIG.max_handoff_depth from 10 to 50 in src/gui/config.ts (both Zod schema default and DEFAULT_CONFIG). Updated getMaxHandoffDepth() fallback from 10 to 50. Updated affected tests in tests/gui/config.test.ts and tests/gui/api.test.ts. Updated JSDoc in buildHandoffResponse. Build passes, 191 tests pass.

comments.note: gui/config.ts: Changing DEFAULT_CONFIG.max_handoff_depth from 10 to 50 will affect any deployed instance that has never written a gui-config.json — it will get a 5x larger auto-handoff depth limit on first init. This is intentional per spec but reviewers of deployed environments should be aware.

workflow-helpers.ts: effectiveMaxDepth accepts an optional configMax second parameter, making it testable with an injected value. This is a good pattern that avoids hidden config-singleton coupling in unit tests.

summary: Verified effectiveMaxDepth implementation: Math.max(configMax, totalWPs×20) with configMax defaulting to getMaxHandoffDepth()=50. All three AC values confirmed by code inspection: effectiveMaxDepth(0)=50, effectiveMaxDepth(1)=50, effectiveMaxDepth(5)=100. buildHandoffResponse confirmed using effectiveMaxDepth(root.total_work_packages ?? 0) at workflow-handoff.ts:190. DEFAULT_CONFIG.max_handoff_depth=50 in gui/config.ts confirmed. tsc build clean. 774 tests pass.

comments.note: No dedicated unit tests for effectiveMaxDepth in workflow-helpers.test.ts. The three AC cases (0→50, 1→50, 5→100) are verified via code inspection: Math.max(configMax=50, totalWPs×20). Integration coverage exists in handoff-config-integration.test.ts. Consider adding a describe('effectiveMaxDepth') block with explicit parameterized tests for the floor and scale cases.

summary: Reviewed effectiveMaxDepth in workflow-helpers.ts and its usage in buildHandoffResponse. Implementation is clean: Math.max(configMax, totalWPs × 20) with configMax defaulting to getMaxHandoffDepth()=50. Null-safety guard (?? 0) on total_work_packages in buildHandoffResponse is correct. Optional configMax parameter for test injection is an excellent pattern. DEFAULT_CONFIG update to 50 is intentional per spec. No blocking issues.

comments.note: workflow-helpers.ts: effectiveMaxDepth's optional configMax second parameter is an excellent testability pattern — it avoids config-singleton coupling in unit tests without requiring additional mocking infrastructure. This pattern should be applied to other helpers that call getMaxHandoffDepth() or similar config-reading singletons when adding new tests.

workflow-helpers.ts: The 20× multiplier in effectiveMaxDepth is hardcoded. For current workflows (7 agents, up to ~20 WPs) this is more than adequate. If future plans include many-WP projects (50+), the effective ceiling could exceed 1000 — worth documenting the multiplier origin in the spec reference. Non-blocking.

No dedicated unit tests for effectiveMaxDepth in workflow-helpers.test.ts. The AC boundary cases (floor at 0, floor at 1, scale at 5) are trivially verifiable and would serve as living documentation of §18.2.1. Non-blocking.
